question: What is the nature and origin of the water called Viṣṇu-Puṣkaraka?
premises: It is described as arisen from all sacred places.
inference: The water called Viṣṇu-Puṣkaraka is said to have arisen from all sacred places.
plain_english: The water named Viṣṇu-Puṣkaraka is arisen from all sacred places.
